name: depot
title: Depot Tool Superstore
description: A tool superstore Layout in the manner of a big hardware and power tool retailer. A red service strip with delivery, pickup, payment, order tracking and help links read from the shop's own settings; a white header with the wordmark, a wide search for tools, brands and specs, the account and the cart with its total; a navigation row with a Shop all mega menu (departments, quick links from each department's own specification, its first tools), a Brands menu built from the products' brands, Deals and What's new pills and the department links. The home: a photo hero with the live offers beside it, quick links, a promo board (departments, a kit promo, brand offers, popular tools), today's deals as brand-coloured tiles, a service band, department photo tiles, a brand wall, an Explore products band with tabs and horizontal cards, why shop here, the shop's story and its journal. Cards with a brand plate, the SKU, stock, the price with raised cents, the saving and a compare tick. A department page with a filter sidebar built from the tools' real specification (brand, kit or bare tool, price) and five cards a row; a product page with the gallery, key specifications and what is in the box beside a sticky buy box with delivery and pickup from the shop's own settings, section tabs, the full specification in the shop's own groups, the batteries that fit a bare tool, and an honest reviews area; compare side by side; a cart drawer and the whole checkout; a brands page, the pickup point and delivery and returns from the shop's own settings (honest empty states where the shop has none); the journal, About, Contact, FAQ and policy pages. One colour family from the chosen palette (Signal red by default; Charcoal, Cobalt, Pine or any colour), light by default with a dark mode, Barlow Condensed over Barlow, 10 px panels. English and Arabic.
summary: A tool superstore: red service strip, big search, Shop all mega menu with spec quick links, promo board and deal tiles, department photo tiles, brand wall, Acme-style cards with raised cents, a filter sidebar from the real specification, a product page with a sticky buy box, kits and bare tools, compare and the whole checkout.
tagline: Power tools, hand tools and the batteries that fit.
